40/// @file
41/// @brief The UI document interpreter: `Interpreter::mount` turns a loaded `Document` into reactive state and a view
42/// tree, mounts it through `Mounted` on any `IViewBackend`, and runs its queries, mutations, relations and
43/// commands. Model calls go through a `Dispatcher` (the bridge's model-free seams in an application, a
44/// scripted fake in a test); what only the application can do goes through an `InterpreterHost`; what
45/// screens share — the query cache, the principal's permissions, the formatting facts — is a `Session`.
46

87/// @brief How one model call is sent.
88struct CallOptions {
89 /// @brief Ask the server to evaluate the action's body instead of executing it (spec 5 §7, `ui-evaluate`).
90 bool evaluate = false;
91 /// @brief The mutation declares `"offline": "queue"`: a dispatcher with an offline queue holds a call that cannot
92 /// reach the server and settles the completion when the replay settles.
93 bool queueOffline = false;
94};

104/// @brief One bound model alias: the instance a document's alias names, and the calls made through it.

127/// @brief The interpreter's view of the bridge: binds a model by its type id, privately or to a shared instance.
128class Dispatcher {
129public:
130 Dispatcher() = default;
131 Dispatcher(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
132 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher const&) = delete;
133 Dispatcher(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
134 Dispatcher& operator=(Dispatcher&&) = delete;
135 virtual ~Dispatcher() = default;

137 /// @brief Binds a model.
138 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
139 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
140 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the instance key; empty for the model's shared singleton.
141 /// @return The bound channel. The caller holds it as long as it makes calls through it.
142 [[nodiscard]] virtual std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
143 std::string const& instanceKey) = 0;
144};

146/// @brief Evaluates an action body without running it: the model's type id, the action id and the JSON body in, the
147/// query's value out (spec 5 §7). `ui::evaluatorOver` builds one over the UI service's `ui-evaluate`.
148using Evaluator = std::function<async::Completion<std::string>(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId,
149 std::string const& bodyJson)>;
150
151/// @brief A `Dispatcher` over the bridge's model-free seams: `bindByType`, `executeRaw` and the string-keyed
152/// `attach`, through `RawHandler`.
153///
154/// An evaluation goes through the `Evaluator` it was given, since that envelope belongs to the UI service, not the
155/// bridge; without one it is refused with a `std::runtime_error`. It has no offline queue of its own: `queueOffline`
156/// is ignored unless a `QueueingDispatcher` wraps it. A shared binding without a key is bound unattached, which the
157/// bridge refuses at the first call; the interpreter never binds one, since a `"shared"` alias is a stateless model's
158/// and binds privately.
159class MORPH_API BridgeDispatcher final : public Dispatcher {
160public:
161 /// @brief Dispatches through @p bridge, and evaluates through @p evaluator.
162 /// @param bridge The bridge. Borrowed: it must outlive every channel.
163 /// @param cbExec The executor replies are delivered on: the runtime's owner. Borrowed.
164 /// @param evaluator What answers an `evaluate` query; empty to refuse them.
165 BridgeDispatcher(bridge::Bridge& bridge MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, exec::IExecutor* cbExec MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
166 Evaluator evaluator = {})
167 : _bridge{&bridge}, _cbExec{cbExec}, _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)} {}
168
169 /// @brief Binds through a `RawHandler`.
170 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
171 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
172 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the key to attach to; empty to stay unattached.
173 /// @return The channel; destroying it deregisters the binding.
174 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
175 std::string const& instanceKey) override;
176
177private:
178 class Channel;
179
180 bridge::Bridge* _bridge;
181 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
182 Evaluator _evaluator;
183};

189/// @brief What `navigate` asks the host to open (spec 6 §16, §20).

226/// @brief The inline cap a session has unless it is given another: 1 MiB.
227inline constexpr std::size_t kDefaultInlineFileBytes = std::size_t{1024} * 1024;
228
229/// @brief The largest inline cap a session takes: base64 grows bytes by 4/3, and 64 KiB of an envelope are left for
230/// the rest of the body, so the encoded file still fits `wire::kMaxEnvelopeBytes` (8 MiB).
231inline constexpr std::size_t kMaxInlineFileBytes = ((std::size_t{8} * 1024 * 1024) - (std::size_t{64} * 1024)) * 3 / 4;

233/// @brief What the application answers for the commands a document cannot carry out alone (spec 6). Every default
234/// answers "not supported", which the interpreter reports as a diagnostic.
235class MORPH_API InterpreterHost {
236public:
237 InterpreterHost() = default;
238 InterpreterHost(InterpreterHost const&) = delete;
239 InterpreterHost& operator=(InterpreterHost const&) = delete;
240 InterpreterHost(InterpreterHost&&) = delete;
241 InterpreterHost& operator=(InterpreterHost&&) = delete;
242 virtual ~InterpreterHost() = default;
243
244 // NOLINTBEGIN(performance-unnecessary-value-param,bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): every default below

249 /// @param onResult Called with the value a screen opened as a dialog, drawer or window returns.
250 /// @param onCancel Called when such a screen closes without a value.
251 /// @return Whether the host opened it.
252 virtual bool navigate(NavigateRequest const& request, std::function<void(Value)> onResult,
253 std::function<void()> onCancel);
254
255 /// @brief Ends the screen that ran `return` or `close: self`.
256 /// @param screen The screen's id.
257 /// @param result The value of `return`; `std::nullopt` for `close: self`.
258 /// @return Whether the screen was opened as something that can end.
259 virtual bool closeSelf(std::string const& screen, std::optional<Value> result);

261 /// @brief Runs a command the application registered (`host/1`).
262 /// @param name The command.
263 /// @param args Its arguments; `null` when none.
264 /// @return Whether the command exists.
265 virtual bool hostCommand(std::string const& name, Value const& args);
266
267 /// @brief Switches to a backend the application's source lists (`AppSource::switchBackend`, spec 6 §9).
268 ///
269 /// The switch is asynchronous: the host calls @p done once, on the runtime's owner, when it committed or failed.
270 /// A failed switch leaves the old backend in place.
271 /// @param name The backend.
272 /// @param done Called once with nothing when the switch committed, or with why it failed. Not called when the
273 /// backend is not listed.
274 /// @return Whether it is listed.
275 virtual bool switchBackend(std::string const& name, std::function<void(std::expected<void, std::string>)> done);
276
277 /// @brief The document reset a customization point, or all of them; the host forgets the stored choice.

280 virtual void resetPrefs(std::string const& screen, std::string const& point);
281

286 /// @brief Shows a transient message.
287 /// @param text The message.
288 /// @param role `info`, `success`, `warning` or `error`; empty for the default.

290 virtual bool notify(std::string const& text, std::string const& role);

293 /// @param reply The mutation's reply, secret fields included.

295 virtual bool signIn(Value const& reply);

297 /// @brief Ends the session. The interpreter has already cleared the session's query cache.
298 virtual void signOut() {}

300 /// @brief Writes `app.name` with `set` (spec 6 §5).
301 /// @param name The app state's name.
302 /// @param value The value.

306 /// @brief Sends a file through the server's file side channel (`files/1`).
307 /// @param file What the user picked or dropped.
308 /// @param progress Called with the progress, 0 to 1.
309 /// @param done Called once with the file's reference, or the failure's text.
310 /// @return Whether the host can send files.

315 /// interpreter calls this one; the default calls `upload(file, …)`, so a host that overrides only that

318 /// @param progress Called with the progress, 0 to 1.

324 /// @brief Fetches a file by reference to save it, or to a local temporary reference for a viewer.
325 /// @param file The file's reference.

328 /// @param done Called once with the local reference (`preview`) or `null` (`dialog`), or the failure.

333 /// @brief Reads a file's bytes for `upload` into bytes. A host reads the file's size first and refuses one over

337 /// @param done Called once with the file, or the failure's text.

342 /// @brief Saves a file a document holds the bytes of, for `download` from bytes.
343 /// @param file The file.

345 /// @param done Called once with the local reference (`preview`) or `null` (`dialog`), or the failure.
346 /// @return Whether the host can save files.
347 virtual bool saveFile(InlineFile const& file, std::string const& option,
348 std::function<void(std::expected<Value, std::string>)> done);
349
350 /// @brief The user chose at a customization point through a `customize` editor; the host stores the choice.
351 /// @param screen The screen's id.
352 /// @param point The point.
353 /// @param value The choice.
354 virtual void preferenceChanged(std::string const& screen, std::string const& point, Value const& value);
355
356 /// @brief A call was refused with error kind `denied`: the permitted set is a snapshot, so the host asks the
357 /// server again and calls `Session::setPermitted`.
358 virtual void permissionsStale() {}
359 // NOLINTEND(performance-unnecessary-value-param,bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters)
360};

366/// @brief Sends a `watch` or `unwatch` request for a session's cache (spec 8 §7): the kind, and the `WatchBody` as

370/// @brief What a `Session` is built with.
371struct SessionOptions {
372 /// @brief Timers for `debounce`, `refreshEvery` and the cache's eviction. Without one, `debounce` fetches at once,
373 /// `refreshEvery` never ticks and unused entries are kept. Borrowed.
374 reactive::Scheduler* scheduler = nullptr;
375 /// @brief The clock `staleTime` is measured on; empty uses `std::chrono::steady_clock`.
376 std::function<std::chrono::milliseconds()> clock;
377 /// @brief How long an entry no mounted query uses is kept (spec 5 §5: five minutes).
378 std::chrono::milliseconds keepUnused{std::chrono::minutes{5}};
379 /// @brief The catalog: `stateless` decides an alias's default instance; an action's `secretFields` are never
380 /// cached or kept in `result`.
381 Catalog catalog;
382 /// @brief Maps a failed call to its error kind (`denied`, `offline`, `timeout`, …); empty uses the default,
383 /// which knows the bridge's own failures and calls everything else `error`.
384 std::function<std::string(std::exception_ptr const&)> classify;
385 /// @brief Development mode: whether this session's screens record what the inspector reads. Off by default.
386 DevelopmentTools developmentTools = DevelopmentTools::Off;
387 /// @brief Sends the cache's watch changes to the server. Empty: the session still counts what its cache holds,
388 /// and sends nothing, which is right for a local source, whose replies carry every change it sees.
389 Watcher watcher;
390 /// @brief The most bytes a document moves inline in one file (`download` from bytes, `upload` into bytes, a
391 /// field component writing a base64 member); 1 to `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
392 std::size_t maxInlineFileBytes = kDefaultInlineFileBytes;
393};

453/// @brief One entry of the session's query cache (spec 5 §5): one request in flight, one value, one error.
454struct MORPH_API CacheEntry {
455 /// @brief An empty entry.
456 /// @param runtime The runtime its signals belong to.
457 explicit CacheEntry(reactive::Runtime& runtime)
458 : value{runtime},
459 hasValue{runtime, false},
460 error{runtime},
461 errorKind{runtime},
462 refusal{runtime},
463 pending{runtime, false} {}
464
465 /// @brief The cache key: model type, instance, action and canonical body.
466 std::string key;
467 /// @brief The model type.
468 std::string typeId;
469 /// @brief The action.
470 std::string action;
471 /// @brief The body's JSON text.
472 std::string body;
473 /// @brief Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
474 bool evaluate = false;
475 /// @brief The value shown: the confirmed value with the optimistic layers over it.
476 reactive::Signal<Value> value;
477 /// @brief Whether a reply has been applied.
478 reactive::Signal<bool> hasValue;
479 /// @brief The last failure's text; empty when none.
480 reactive::Signal<std::string> error;
481 /// @brief The last failure's kind; empty when none.
482 reactive::Signal<std::string> errorKind;
483 /// @brief The last failure's action refusal; `null` when none or when it was not a refusal.
484 reactive::Signal<Value> refusal;
485 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight.
486 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
487 /// @brief The value the server last confirmed.
488 Value confirmed;
489 /// @brief The optimistic writes still waiting, oldest first.
490 std::vector<OptimisticLayer> layers;
491 /// @brief The generation of the request in flight; a reply of an older one is dropped.
492 std::uint64_t generation = 0;
493 /// @brief When the last reply was applied.
494 std::optional<std::chrono::milliseconds> fetchedAt;
495 /// @brief Marked stale by a `refetch`, a backend switch or a change.
496 bool stale = false;
497 /// @brief Marked stale while a fetch was in flight: that fetch may have read before the change, so when it
498 /// settles the entry stays stale and fetches once more.
499 bool refetchAfter = false;
500 /// @brief The mounted queries using it.
501 int users = 0;
502 /// @brief The eviction timer, while no query uses it.
503 reactive::TimerHandle evict;
504 /// @brief The fields never cached.
505 std::vector<std::string> secretFields;
506 /// @brief The alias's instance token the entry was read through.
507 std::string instanceToken;
508 /// @brief The records the entry's action returns, with the key field and paths of each; empty for an
509 /// `evaluate` entry, which holds none.
510 std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> records;
511
512 /// @brief The catalog entry of a record the entry holds.
513 /// @param record The record's wire name.
514 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when the entry does not hold the record.
515 [[nodiscard]] ActionRecordInfo const* holding(std::string_view record) const;
516};

561/// @brief What running a host command (`host/1`) did.
562struct HostCommandResult {
563 /// @brief The outcome.
564 enum class Kind : std::uint8_t {
565 Ran, ///< The command ran.
566 Missing, ///< The client has no such command; nothing ran.
567 Refused, ///< The command exists and did not run: its arguments, or a connection that is not verified.

575/// @brief The client's host commands, as a session runs them (spec 6 §14).
576struct HostCommands {
577 /// @brief The commands the client can run now; `{"can": "host:name"}` is true for these.
578 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> available;
579 /// @brief Runs a command with its evaluated `args` (`null` when the document gives none).
580 std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const& name, Value const& args)> run;
581};
582
583/// @brief What screens of one client session share (spec 5 §5, §12b): the query cache, the mounted queries, the
584/// principal's permitted actions, the formatting facts and the client's `env`, `session` and `host` values.
585///
586/// It belongs to the runtime's owner, outlives every screen mounted on it, and is cleared by `signOut` and on a
587/// principal change.
588class MORPH_API Session {
589public:
590 /// @brief An empty session.
591 /// @param runtime The runtime. Borrowed.
592 /// @param options Timers, clock, catalog and the inline cap.
593 /// @throws std::invalid_argument when `maxInlineFileBytes` is 0 or above `kMaxInlineFileBytes`.
594 explicit Session(reactive::Runtime& runtime MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, SessionOptions options = {})
595 : _runtime{&runtime},
596 _options{checkedOptions(std::move(options))},
597 _permitted{runtime},
598 _format{runtime, std::make_shared<FormatContext const>()},
599 _env{runtime, ValueRecord{{"locale", Value{FormatContext{}.locale}}}},
600 _sessionValues{runtime},
601 _hostValues{runtime},
602 _hostCommandNames{runtime},
603 _contextOffered{runtime, false} {}
604
605 Session(Session const&) = delete;
606 Session& operator=(Session const&) = delete;
607 Session(Session&&) = delete;
608 Session& operator=(Session&&) = delete;
609 ~Session() = default;
610
611 /// @brief The runtime.
612 /// @return It.
613 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return *_runtime; }
614
615 /// @brief The options.
616 /// @return They.
617 [[nodiscard]] SessionOptions const& options() const noexcept { return _options; }
618
619 /// @brief Sets the action ids the principal may run, as the catalog reply lists them; `{"can": ...}` follows them.
620 /// @param permitted The ids.
621 void setPermitted(std::set<std::string, std::less<>> permitted) { _permitted.set(std::move(permitted)); }
622
623 /// @brief Whether the principal may run an action, or the client can run a host command now. A tracked read.
624 ///
625 /// A `host:` name is answered from the client's own commands (`setHostCommands`), never from the server's
626 /// permitted set: the two have different owners, and a catalog refresh must not drop the client's commands.
627 /// @param action The action id, or `host:<command>`.
628 /// @return Whether it is permitted.
629 [[nodiscard]] bool can(std::string_view action) const;
630
631 /// @brief Says whether a scope switcher with at least one option is installed, which is when `{"can": "context"}`
632 /// holds and the `setContext` command can run.
633 /// @param offered Whether it is.
634 void setContextOffered(bool offered) { _contextOffered.set(offered); }
635
636 /// @brief Installs what runs the `setContext` command: the shell, which checks the value against the switcher's
637 /// options and asks before discarding unsaved work. An empty function removes it.
638 /// @param handler It gets the requested value and answers whether it accepted the request.
639 void setContextHandler(std::function<bool(Value const&)> handler) { _contextHandler = std::move(handler); }
640
641 /// @brief Asks the installed handler to change the context.
642 /// @param value The option value requested.
643 /// @return Whether a handler accepted it; `false` with none installed.
644 bool requestContext(Value const& value) const { return _contextHandler && _contextHandler(value); }
645
646 /// @brief Sets the scope every screen reads as `{"env": "context"}`.
647 /// @param value The chosen option's value; `null` for none.
648 void setContext(Value value) { setEnvironmentValue("context", std::move(value)); }
649
650 /// @brief Chooses the number, money and date facts apart from the language. The choice stays through later
651 /// `setLocale` calls, until an empty tag clears it.
652 /// @param tag The BCP 47 tag whose facts apply; empty follows the language.
653 void setFormatLocale(std::string tag);
654
655 /// @brief The facts a locale scope writes in: the session's with @p tag's row of the locale table (separators,
656 /// sign, currency placement) and the date patterns the application declared, else that row's. The facts
657 /// come from the tag alone, whatever `setFormatLocale` chose. A tracked read of the session's facts.
658 /// @param tag The scope's BCP 47 tag.
659 /// @return The facts; `locale` is @p tag, and a tag the table does not list writes with `en`'s row.
660 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const> scopedFormatting(std::string_view tag) const;
661
662 /// @brief The session's own facts, shared. A tracked read.
663 /// @return They.
664 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const> sharedFormatting() const { return _format.get(); }
665
666 /// @brief Whether a locale scope's tag is one to report: the locale table lists no row for it, and no scope has
667 /// reported it before. The answer is true once per tag for the session's lifetime.
668 /// @param tag The tag.
669 /// @return Whether to report it now.
670 [[nodiscard]] bool firstUnlistedLocale(std::string const& tag);
671
672 /// @brief The tag chosen with `setFormatLocale`.
673 /// @return It; empty when the facts follow the language.
674 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& formatLocale() const noexcept { return _formatLocale; }
675
676 /// @brief Replaces the formatting facts; every `t` and display function re-evaluates. `{"env": "locale"}` follows
677 /// the facts' locale.
678 /// @param format The facts.
679 void setFormatting(FormatContext format);
680
681 /// @brief The formatting facts. A tracked read.
682 /// @return They.
683 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const { return *_format.get(); }
684
685 /// @brief The formatting facts, read without tracking: what a value set once at mount reads.
686 /// @return They.
687 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formattingNow() const { return *_format.peek(); }
688
689 /// @brief Sets the patterns every date and every date and time is written and read in, keeping the other
690 /// formatting facts. A non-empty pattern is the application's: it stays through every `setLocale`. An empty
691 /// one is not declared: the active locale's pattern applies, and ISO where the locale has none.
692 /// @param date The date pattern, such as `dd-MMM-yyyy`.
693 /// @param dateTime The date-and-time pattern, such as `dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm`.
694 void setDatePatterns(std::string date, std::string dateTime);
695
696 /// @brief Changes the active locale and installs its facts from the locale table (`localeFacts`): the separators
697 /// and currency symbols, and the date patterns the application did not declare
698 /// (`setDatePatterns`). The other formatting facts stay.
699 /// @param locale The BCP 47 locale.
700 void setLocale(std::string locale) { applyFacts(std::move(locale)); }
701
702 /// @brief Replaces the message catalogue, keeping the other formatting facts; every `t` re-resolves.
703 /// @param translations The provider, such as `MessageCatalogues::provider()`; empty shows every fallback.
704 void setTranslations(render::TranslationProvider translations);
705
706 /// @brief Sets the `env` values (`widthClass`, `platform`, `online`, `backend`). `locale` is the formatting
707 /// facts' locale and is always present: a `locale` in @p values is replaced by it.
708 /// @param values The values.
709 void setEnvironment(ValueRecord values);
710
711 /// @brief Sets one `env` value and keeps the others, so a client that learns its width class does not drop the
712 /// `backend` a switch set, nor a switch the width class.
713 /// @param name The value's name, such as `widthClass`.
714 /// @param value The value.
715 void setEnvironmentValue(std::string const& name, Value value);
716
717 /// @brief Sets the `session` values (`principal`, `userName`, …).
718 /// @param values The values.
719 void setSessionValues(ValueRecord values) { _sessionValues.set(std::move(values)); }
720
721 /// @brief Sets the `host` values the application registered.
722 /// @param values The values.
723 void setHostValues(ValueRecord values) { _hostValues.set(std::move(values)); }
724
725 /// @brief Sets the client's host commands: the names `{"can": "host:name"}` answers for, and what runs them. A
726 /// session without a runner asks `InterpreterHost::hostCommand`.
727 /// @param commands The names and the runner.
728 void setHostCommands(HostCommands commands);
729
730 /// @brief What runs host commands.
731 /// @return It; empty when the application set none.
732 [[nodiscard]] std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const&, Value const&)> const& hostCommandRunner()
733 const noexcept;
734
735 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`. A tracked read.
736 /// @param form `Env`, `Session` or `Host`.
737 /// @param name The name.
738 /// @return The value, or `null`.
739 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const;
740
741 /// @brief The app document's scope, which `{"ref": "app.name"}` reads and `{"set": "app.name"}` writes; set by
742 /// `Interpreter::mountApp` for as long as the `AppRoot` lives.
743 /// @return It, or `nullptr` when no app document is mounted.
744 [[nodiscard]] detail::RtScope const* appScope() const noexcept { return _appScope; }
745
746 /// @brief Installs or clears the app document's scope. Called by `AppRoot`, nothing else.
747 /// @param scope The scope, or `nullptr`.
748 void setAppScope(detail::RtScope const* scope) noexcept { _appScope = scope; }
749
750 /// @brief Drops every cache entry: `signOut` and a principal change (spec 5 §5, "Isolation").
751 void clear();
752
753 /// @brief Carries out a committed backend switch (spec 6 §9), in one batch: every mounted screen's
754 /// `onBackendChange` runs first, then every entry is marked stale and the mounted queries refetch, and
755 /// `{"env": "backend"}` becomes @p backend. A query on a private alias therefore never fetches before its
756 /// screen has recovered from the switch.
757 /// @param backend The backend now in use.
758 void backendChanged(std::string const& backend);
759
760 /// @brief Registers a mounted screen or app document, whose `onBackendChange` a backend switch runs.
761 /// @param screen It. Borrowed until `detachScreen`.
762 void attachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { _screens.push_back(&screen); }
763
764 /// @brief Forgets a screen or app document.
765 /// @param screen It.
766 void detachScreen(detail::ScreenCore& screen) { std::erase(_screens, &screen); }
767
768 /// @brief Starts a query's request before its screen mounts, so the screen mounts on a warm cache.
769 /// @param channel The alias's channel.
770 /// @param token The alias's instance token (`Screen::instanceToken`).
771 /// @param typeId The model type.
772 /// @param action The action.
773 /// @param body The body.
774 void prefetch(std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel, std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
775 std::string const& action, Value const& body);
776
777 /// @brief The number of entries in the cache.
778 /// @return It.
779 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t cacheSize() const noexcept { return _entries.size(); }
780
781 /// @brief A fresh instance token for a private alias: what the cache key holds for its instance.
782 /// @return It, unique in the session.
783 [[nodiscard]] std::string privateToken() { return "private#" + std::to_string(++_privateTokens); }
784
785 /// @brief Whether the newest write to a document source was made by a user event (spec 5 §6, `source: "user"`).
786 /// @return It.
787 [[nodiscard]] bool lastWriteByUser() const noexcept { return _lastWriteUser; }
788
789 /// @brief Records a write to a document source.
790 void noteWrite() noexcept { _lastWriteUser = _userDepth > 0; }
791
792 /// @brief Runs @p body as a user event: what it writes counts as the user's.
793 /// @param body The body.
794 void asUser(std::function<void()> const& body);
795
796 /// @brief The cache key of a query.
797 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
798 /// @param typeId The model type.
799 /// @param action The action.
800 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
801 /// @param body The canonical body.
802 /// @return The key.
803 [[nodiscard]] static std::string cacheKey(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
804 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, std::string const& body);
805
806 /// @brief Finds or makes an entry and counts one more user.
807 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
808 /// @param typeId The model type.
809 /// @param action The action.
810 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
811 /// @param body The body.
812 /// @return The entry.
813 std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> acquire(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
814 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, Value const& body);
815
816 /// @brief Counts one user less; an entry nobody uses is dropped after `keepUnused`.
817 /// @param entry The entry.
818 void release(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry);
819
820 /// @brief Sends an entry's request under a new generation; a reply of an older generation is dropped.
821 /// @param entry The entry.
822 /// @param channel The channel to send it through; `nullptr` fails the request at once.
823 void fetch(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry, std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel);
824
825 /// @brief Writes an entry's confirmed value and re-applies its optimistic layers over it.
826 /// @param entry The entry.
827 /// @param confirmed The confirmed value.
828 void confirm(detail::CacheEntry& entry, Value const& confirmed);
829
830 /// @brief Recomputes what an entry shows from its confirmed value and its layers.
831 /// @param entry The entry.
832 void showLayers(detail::CacheEntry& entry);
833
834 /// @brief The error kind of a failure.
835 /// @param error The failure.
836 /// @return The kind.
837 [[nodiscard]] std::string classify(std::exception_ptr const& error) const;
838
839 /// @brief The clock.
840 /// @return Now.
841 [[nodiscard]] std::chrono::milliseconds now() const;
842
843 /// @brief Registers a mounted query, which a reconnect and a backend switch refetch.
844 /// @param query The query.
845 void attachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { _mounted.push_back(&query); }
846
847 /// @brief Unregisters a mounted query.
848 /// @param query The query.
849 void forgetQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { std::erase(_mounted, &query); }
850
851 /// @brief A call of @p actionId on a model of @p typeId succeeded: applies the action's effects to the cache
852 /// (spec 8 §9).
853 ///
854 /// `updates R` merges the reply's rows of `R` into each entry holding `R`, matched by the record's key field at
855 /// the entry's paths, with no fetch; an entry whose fetch is in flight also fetches once more, since that fetch
856 /// may have read before the write. `changes R` marks each entry holding `R` stale. `changesInstance` marks each
857 /// entry read through the same instance. A marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it. A
858 /// discarded reply only marks: its `updates` act as `changes`.
859 /// @param typeId The model type.
860 /// @param actionId The action.
861 /// @param reply The reply's value.
862 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
863 /// @param instanceToken The instance token of the alias the call went through.
864 void actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
865 std::string const& instanceToken);
866
867 /// @brief The connection to the server was made again (spec 8 §7, "Reconnect"): sends the whole watch set with
868 /// `replace: true`, then marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale. A mounted entry refetches, and one
869 /// whose fetch is in flight fetches once more when that fetch settles, so a change missed while the
870 /// connection was down is read again.
871 void reconnected();
872
873 /// @brief The topics the cache holds now: every record an entry holds, and the keyed shared instance of every
874 /// entry whose action holds no record. What `reconnected` sends.
875 /// @return The topics, records and instances each in name order; `replace` is false.
876 [[nodiscard]] wire::WatchBody watchSet() const;
877
878 /// @brief Applies a server event to the cache (spec 8 §9).
879 ///
880 /// A `changes` event marks the entries it names stale, and a `resync` sends the whole watch set again, as
881 /// `reconnected` does, and marks every entry but an `evaluate` one;
882 /// each marked entry refetches through a mounted query that uses it, and one no query uses refetches when a
883 /// query mounts on it. An event of another topic, or a payload that cannot be read, is ignored.
884 /// @param event The event.
885 void deliverEvent(wire::EventBody const& event);
886
887 /// @brief Applies a `changes` event's payload to the cache, in one reactive batch.
888 ///
889 /// A record change with keys marks each entry holding the record whose value has a row with one of the keys,
890 /// and an entry holding it keyless; a record change without keys marks every entry holding the record. An
891 /// instance change marks every entry read through that instance: the keyed shared one its primary key names,
892 /// or, with no primary key, the connection's own private ones of that model type.
893 /// @param changes The payload.
894 void applyChanges(wire::ChangesBody const& changes);
895
896 /// @brief Marks an entry stale. While its fetch is in flight, the entry also refetches once that fetch settles,
897 /// because the fetch may have read before the change.
898 /// @param entry The entry.
899 static void markStale(detail::CacheEntry& entry);
900
901private:
902 // A cap of 0 moves nothing inline, and one above the largest would not fit an envelope once encoded.
903 [[nodiscard]] static SessionOptions checkedOptions(SessionOptions options);
904
905 void settleReply(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string const& reply);
906
907 /// @brief Refetches an entry through the mounted queries that use it; one fetch even when several do.
908 /// @param entry The entry.
909 void refetchMounted(detail::CacheEntry const& entry);
910
911 /// @brief Applies a reply's effects to the cache, for `actionSucceeded`.
912 /// @param typeId The model type.
913 /// @param actionId The action.
914 /// @param reply The reply's value.
915 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
916 /// @param instanceToken The instance token of the alias the call went through.
917 void applyReplyEffects(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId, Value const& reply, ReplyUse use,
918 std::string const& instanceToken);
919
920 /// @brief Counts an entry's topics in or out, queueing a `watch` for a count that leaves zero and an `unwatch`
921 /// for one that returns to it.
922 /// @param entry The entry.
923 /// @param delta `+1` when the entry is made, `-1` when it is dropped.
924 void countTopics(detail::CacheEntry const& entry, int delta);
925
926 /// @brief Sends the queued watch changes, at most one `watch` and one `unwatch`; drops them when there is no
927 /// watcher.
928 void flushWatches();
929
930 /// @brief Sends one watch request, ignoring its reply: a refused topic simply sends no events.
931 /// @param kind The kind, `watch` or `unwatch`.
932 /// @param body The body.
933 void sendWatch(std::string_view kind, wire::WatchBody const& body) const;
934
935 /// @brief Marks every entry but an `evaluate` one stale and refetches the mounted ones, in one batch.
936 void markAllStale();
937
938 /// @brief Marks each entry of @p marks stale and refetches it through a mounted query that uses it.
939 /// @param marks The entries.
940 void markAndRefetch(detail::Marks const& marks);
941
942 /// @brief Applies one `updates` or `changes` effect of a reply: patches the entries holding the record, or marks
943 /// them.
944 /// @param effect The effect.
945 /// @param record The record it names.
946 /// @param info The action's catalog entry, for the records its reply holds.
947 /// @param reply The reply's value.
948 /// @param use Whether the reply was applied or discarded.
949 /// @param marks Where entries to mark go.
950 void applyRecordEffect(ActionEffect const& effect, std::string const& record, ActionInfo const& info,
951 Value const& reply, ReplyUse use, detail::Marks& marks);
952
953 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's record change names.
954 /// @param change The change.
955 /// @param marks Where they go.
956 void markRecordChange(effects::RecordChange const& change, detail::Marks& marks);
957
958 /// @brief Finds the entries a `changes` event's instance change names.
959 /// @param instance The instance.
960 /// @param marks Where they go.
961 void markInstanceChange(wire::InstanceTopic const& instance, detail::Marks& marks);
962
963 void settleFailure(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string text, std::string kind, Value refusal = Value{});
964
965 static void detachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query);
966
967 reactive::Runtime* _runtime;
968 SessionOptions _options;
969 reactive::Signal<std::set<std::string, std::less<>>> _permitted;
970 std::map<std::string, int, std::less<>> _recordRefs;
971 std::map<std::pair<std::string, std::string>, int> _instanceRefs;
972 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _watchRecords;
973 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _unwatchRecords;
974 std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> _watchInstances;
975 // Installs the facts of @p locale's row, or of the chosen format locale's row where one is chosen, and names
976 // @p locale as the language.
977 void applyFacts(std::string locale);
978
979 std::set<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> _unwatchInstances;
980 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const>> _format;
981 // What the application declared (`setDatePatterns`) and what the locale installed (`setLocale`), per pattern.
982 std::string _declaredDate;
983 std::string _declaredDateTime;
984 std::string _localeDate;
985 std::string _localeDateTime;
986 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _env;
987 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _sessionValues;
988 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _hostValues;
989 detail::RtScope const* _appScope = nullptr;
990 std::vector<detail::ScreenCore*> _screens;
991 reactive::Signal<std::set<std::string, std::less<>>> _hostCommandNames;
992 reactive::Signal<bool> _contextOffered;
993 std::function<bool(Value const&)> _contextHandler;
994 std::string _formatLocale;
995 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _unlistedLocales;
996 std::function<HostCommandResult(std::string const&, Value const&)> _hostCommandRunner;
997 std::map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry>, std::less<>> _entries;
998 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> _mounted;
999 int _userDepth = 0;
1000 bool _lastWriteUser = false;
1001 std::uint64_t _privateTokens = 0;
1002};

1007/// @brief A model the opener lends to a screen whose alias says `{"from": alias}` (spec 6 §16).

1011 /// @brief The opener's instance token, so the two share cache entries.

1013};

1015class Screen;

1017class Inspector;

1019/// @brief One command of a command list the inspector's log shows (spec 6 §21).

1029/// @brief One command list as it ran: the event that ran it, its commands, and the reactive batch they ran in.

1033 /// @brief Its commands, in order.

1036 /// every batch.

1040/// @brief What `Interpreter::mount` is given beside the document.

1046 /// @brief The reactive scope depth of the screen's own scope.

1049 /// state of the new screen's own scope starts from that screen's value of the state of the same name and
1050 /// type, instead of from its init. Borrowed for the call.
1051 Screen const* keepStateOf = nullptr;
1052};

1054namespace detail {

1056/// @brief A name bound for the expressions of one place: a command's `event`, a step's `as`, `result` in a
1057/// `patch`, `body` in an `optimistic`, `props` in a fallback, `boundary` in a boundary's `error`.

1066using Bindings = std::vector<Binding>;

1068class ScreenCore;

1071class MutationRuntime;

1075/// @brief One state declaration at run time.
1076struct StateSlot {
1077 /// @brief The declaration.
1078 StateDecl const* decl = nullptr;
1079 /// @brief The value, made when the init is evaluated.
1080 std::unique_ptr<reactive::Signal<Value>> value;
1081 /// @brief The scope that declares it, where its init is evaluated.
1082 RtScope const* scope = nullptr;
1083 /// @brief Set while the init is evaluated, so a cyclic read gives `null` instead of recursing.
1084 bool initializing = false;
1085};

1087/// @brief One model alias at run time: the instance it names, and the channel bound to it.
1088struct ModelAlias {
1089 /// @brief The declaration.
1090 ModelDecl const* decl = nullptr;
1091 /// @brief `Private`, `Shared`, `Keyed` or `Borrowed`, the default resolved through the catalog.
1092 InstanceMode mode = InstanceMode::Private;
1093 /// @brief The instance token: what the cache key holds for the instance; empty while unbound (a `null` key).
1094 reactive::Computed<std::string>* token = nullptr;
1095 /// @brief The channel of the token it was last bound for.
1096 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel;
1097 /// @brief That token.
1098 std::string boundToken;
1099};

1101/// @brief The values of an `upload` transfer id (spec 6 §18).
1102struct TransferState {
1103 /// @brief An idle transfer.
1104 /// @param runtime The runtime.
1105 explicit TransferState(reactive::Runtime& runtime) : progress{runtime}, pending{runtime, false}, error{runtime} {}
1106 /// @brief 0 to 1, or `null`.
1107 reactive::Signal<Value> progress;
1108 /// @brief Whether it is running.
1109 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
1110 /// @brief The failure's text, or `null`.
1111 reactive::Signal<Value> error;
1112};

1114/// @brief The field of a table's heading entry that holds the heading row's key; the rest of the entry is the run
1115/// record its heading reads. A data row with this field would be taken for a heading.
1116inline constexpr std::string_view kGroupHeadingField = "\x1Fgroup";

1118/// @brief A table's rows as the table shows them: every row `rows` gave, in the order of the table's sort, and the
1119/// page of them it shows.
1120struct TableView {
1121 /// @brief The rows, sorted: every page.
1122 std::vector<Value> rows;
1123 /// @brief With `group`, each row's group: its index in `runs`; empty without.
1124 std::vector<std::size_t> runOf;
1125 /// @brief With `group`, each group's heading entry: the run record of the whole group, in source order, and its
1126 /// heading key in `kGroupHeadingField`.
1127 std::vector<Value> runs;
1128 /// @brief The position in `rows` of the page's first row.
1129 std::size_t first = 0;
1130 /// @brief The position in `rows` past the page's last row.
1131 std::size_t last = 0;
1132 /// @brief The page shown, 0-based, clamped to the last page.
1133 std::int64_t page = 0;
1134 /// @brief How many pages there are; at least 1.
1135 std::int64_t pageCount = 1;
1136 /// @brief Equal when the rows are.
1137 /// @param other The other view.

1140};

1142/// @brief An element's live values (spec 5 §6).
1143struct MORPH_API ElementState {

1155 /// @brief The node.

1160 /// a date-time input's timestamp.
1161 reactive::Signal<Value> draft;
1162 /// @brief The committed value of an input whose value no expression binds.
1163 reactive::Signal<Value> committed;

1166 /// @brief Whether it has been committed at least once (Enter or focus leaving after an edit).

1168 /// @brief Whether it has keyboard focus. The view tree reports no focus, so it stays false.

1172 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's `submitted`.

1174 /// @brief A table's selected keys.

1176 /// @brief A table's own sort, a list of keys, while no `sort` key binds one.
1177 reactive::Signal<Value> sort;
1178 /// @brief A table's last activated key.

1180 /// @brief Bumped when a check targeting it comes or goes.

1182 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's scope while its content is mounted.

1189 /// @brief What is wrong now, as a list of strings: `required` unmet, the node's `errors`, the reply's field
1190 /// errors and the failing checks' messages.

1193 reactive::Computed<Value>* rows = nullptr;
1194 /// @brief A table's bound `sort`; `nullptr` while the table holds its own.
1195 reactive::Computed<Value>* sortBound = nullptr;
1196 /// @brief A table's rows as it shows them, made beside `rows` so that every reader of the table's element
1197 /// values, the table's own lowering included, sees one order; `nullptr` for a table without `rows`.
1198 reactive::Computed<TableView>* view = nullptr;
1199 /// @brief A `form`'s session (spec 2), made when the element is wired; null when its schema is unknown.
1200 std::unique_ptr<forms::FormSession> form;
1201 /// @brief A `collection`'s session (spec 2), made when the element is wired; null when its view document is

1204 /// @brief A `wizard`'s session (spec 2), made when the element is wired; null when its wizard document or a

1260/// @brief One document scope at run time: the screen, a dialog's or drawer's content, a switch case or a row.
1261///
1262/// It lives while anything that reads it does: the view nodes lowered in it hold it by `shared_ptr`, a reply or
1263/// a timer holds it weakly. It belongs to a `ScreenCore`, which outlives it.
1264class MORPH_API RtScope : public std::enable_shared_from_this<RtScope> {
1265public:
1266 /// @brief An empty scope.
1267 /// @param screen The screen.
1268 /// @param enclosing The enclosing scope; `nullptr` for the screen and a component fallback.
1269 /// @param current The row of a row scope; `nullptr` otherwise.
1270 /// @param depth The reactive scope depth of what it owns.
1271 RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
1272 std::size_t depth);
1273
1274 RtScope(RtScope const&) = delete;
1275 RtScope& operator=(RtScope const&) = delete;
1276 RtScope(RtScope&&) = delete;
1277 RtScope& operator=(RtScope&&) = delete;
1278
1279 /// @brief Releases what it owns, and tells the dialog it belongs to.
1280 ~RtScope();
1281
1282 /// @brief Resolves a name, innermost scope first.
1283 /// @param name The name.
1284 /// @return The declaration, or `nullptr`.
1285 [[nodiscard]] NameRef const* find(std::string_view name) const;
1286
1287 /// @brief The innermost row, from this scope outwards.
1288 /// @return The row signal, or `nullptr`.
1289 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Signal<Value> const* innermostRow() const;
1290
1291 /// @brief The innermost scope that decides when errors show and is submitted: a dialog's, or the screen's.
1292 /// @return The scope.
1293 [[nodiscard]] RtScope const& policyScope() const;
1294
1295 /// @brief Whether every element of the scope is valid and no blocking check of it fails. A tracked read.
1296 /// @return It.
1297 [[nodiscard]] bool ready() const;
1298
1299 /// @brief The screen.
1300 ScreenCore& core;
1301 /// @brief The enclosing scope.
1302 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> parent;
1303 /// @brief The row of a row scope.
1304 reactive::Signal<Value> const* row = nullptr;
1305 /// @brief The canonical key of a row scope's row; empty for any other scope.
1306 std::string rowKey;
1307 /// @brief For a component fallback's scope, the focus key of the `custom` node it is lowered for, so one
1308 /// fallback lowered for two uses keys its elements apart; empty for any other scope.
1309 std::string usePrefix;
1310 /// @brief The dialog or drawer whose content it is.
1311 ElementState* owner = nullptr;
1312 /// @brief `touched`, `submit` or `always`, for a scope that decides it.
1313 std::string showErrors;
1314 /// @brief `submitted` of a scope that decides when errors show.
1315 reactive::Signal<bool>* submitted = nullptr;
1316 /// @brief Its names.
1317 std::map<std::string, NameRef, std::less<>> names;
1318 /// @brief Its state.
1319 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<StateSlot>> states;
1320 /// @brief Its elements, in document order.
1321 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ElementState>> elements;
1322 /// @brief Its transfers.
1323 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TransferState>> transfers;
1324 /// @brief Its model aliases.
1325 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ModelAlias>> models;
1326 /// @brief Its queries.
1327 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<QueryRuntime>> queries;
1328 /// @brief Its mutations.
1329 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<MutationRuntime>> mutations;
1330 /// @brief Its checks.
1331 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CheckRuntime>> checks;
1332 /// @brief For a locale scope's scope, the formatting facts it writes in; `nullptr` for any other scope.
1333 reactive::Computed<std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const>>* localeFormat = nullptr;
1334 /// @brief Whether the scope declares nothing: the elements of its nodes are the enclosing scope's.
1335 bool transparent = false;
1336 /// @brief For the scope of a component's fallback, whose names are isolated from the use site's: the use site's
1337 /// scope, which still decides the formatting.
1338 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> formatSource;
1339
1340 /// @brief The formatting facts of this place: the innermost enclosing locale scope's, else the session's. A
1341 /// tracked read.
1342 /// @return They. The reference is into the current facts and holds until the facts are next recomputed; a caller
1343 /// keeps it only while it lowers or evaluates, when nothing writes the session's formatting or a scope's
1344 /// tag.
1345 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const;
1346
1347 /// @brief The reactive nodes it owns; declared last, so they go first.
1348 reactive::Scope nodes;
1349};

1433/// @brief A query at run time (spec 5 §5): a key over the scope, an entry of the session's cache, latest wins.
1434class MORPH_API QueryRuntime {
1435public:
1436 /// @brief A query of @p scope, not yet started.
1437 /// @param decl The declaration.
1438 /// @param scope The scope.
1439 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
1440 QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
1441
1442 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1443 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1444 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1445 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1446
1447 /// @brief Stops its timers and releases its entry.
1448 ~QueryRuntime();
1449
1450 /// @brief Starts it: makes its key and the Effect that follows it, and its refresh timer.
1451 void start();
1452
1453 /// @brief The value: the entry's, kept from the previous key while the new one has none. A tracked read.
1454 /// @return It.
1455 [[nodiscard]] Value value() const;
1456
1457 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight or waiting out its debounce. A tracked read.
1458 /// @return It.
1459 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const;
1460
1461 /// @brief The failure's text, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1462 /// @return It.
1463 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const;
1464
1465 /// @brief The failure's kind, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1466 /// @return It.
1467 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const;
1468
1469 /// @brief The failure's action refusal, `null` when none or when the failure was not a refusal. A tracked read.
1470 /// @return It.
1471 [[nodiscard]] Value refusal() const;
1472
1473 /// @brief Whether the query has a value or a failure for its current key, or is idle. A tracked read, for a
1474 /// boundary.
1475 /// @return It.
1476 [[nodiscard]] bool settled() const;
1477
1478 /// @brief Refetches the current key now, ending a debounce wait.
1479 void refetch();
1480
1481 /// @brief Fetches the key its body has now, inside the batch that changed the body: switches to that key's entry
1482 /// when it differs from the current one, and fetches the current one otherwise. A backend switch uses it,
1483 /// so a body `onBackendChange` changed is fetched once, with what the recovery set, and the old key is
1484 /// not fetched first.
1485 void refetchCurrent();
1486
1487 /// @brief Marks its entry stale and refetches it.
1488 void invalidate();
1489
1490 /// @brief Forgets its entry without releasing it: the session dropped the cache.
1491 void detach();
1492
1493 /// @brief The current entry. A tracked read.
1494 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while idle.
1495 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const& entry() const { return _entry.get(); }
1496
1497 /// @brief The declaration.
1498 /// @return It.
1499 [[nodiscard]] QueryDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
1500
1501 /// @brief The model type.
1502 /// @return It.
1503 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
1504
1505 /// @brief The channel its alias is bound to now.
1506 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
1507 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel() const;
1508
1509private:
1510 /// @brief What a key evaluates to: the cache entry it names and the body, or idle.
1511 struct Target {
1512 bool idle = true;
1513 std::string token;
1514 Value body;
1515 std::string bodyText;
1516 bool operator==(Target const& other) const;
1517 };
1518
1519 void switchTo(Target const& target);
1520
1521 QueryDecl const* _decl;
1522 std::string _typeId;
1523 RtScope* _scope;
1524 ModelAlias* _alias;
1525 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> _entry;
1526 reactive::Signal<Value> _carried;
1527 reactive::Signal<bool> _waiting;
1528 Target _target;
1529 Target _pendingTarget;
1530 // The query's key, owned by its scope's nodes; set once `start` made it.
1531 reactive::Computed<Target> const* _key = nullptr;
1532 reactive::TimerHandle _debounce;
1533 reactive::TimerHandle _refresh;
1534 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
1535};

1537/// @brief One run of a mutation, as a command sees it: whether it succeeded, and the reply.
1538using RunDone = std::function<void(bool succeeded, Value const& reply)>;

1540/// @brief A mutation at run time (spec 5 §5): concurrency, optimistic writes and the reply's effects.
1541class MORPH_API MutationRuntime {
1542public:
1543 /// @brief A mutation of @p scope.
1544 /// @param decl The declaration.
1545 /// @param scope The scope.
1546 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
1547 MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);

1549 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
1550 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
1551 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
1552 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
1553
1554 /// @brief Drops the replies still to come.
1555 ~MutationRuntime();
1556
1557 /// @brief Runs it, queues the run or refuses it, as its concurrency says.
1558 /// @param body The body.
1559 /// @param bindings The names bound where the run was started, for `onSuccess` and `onError`.
1560 /// @param done Called once the run settles, or at once when it is refused.
1561 void run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done);
1562
1563 /// @brief Whether a run is in flight or queued. A tracked read.
1564 /// @return It.
1565 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _inFlight.get() > 0; }
1566
1567 /// @brief The last applied result. A tracked read.
1568 /// @return It.
1569 [[nodiscard]] Value result() const { return _result.get(); }
1570
1571 /// @brief The last applied failure's text, or `null`. A tracked read.
1572 /// @return It.
1573 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const { return _error.get(); }
1574
1575 /// @brief The last applied failure's kind, or `null`. A tracked read.
1576 /// @return It.
1577 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const { return _errorKind.get(); }
1578
1579 /// @brief The last applied failure's action refusal, or `null`. A tracked read.
1580 /// @return It.
1581 [[nodiscard]] Value refusal() const { return _refusal.get(); }
1582
1583 /// @brief The declaration.
1584 /// @return It.
1585 [[nodiscard]] MutationDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
1586
1587 /// @brief The model type.
1588 /// @return It.
1589 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
1590
1591private:
1592 struct Run {
1593 std::uint64_t id = 0;
1594 Value body;
1595 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
1596 RunDone done;
1597 std::string serialKey;
1598 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> layered;
1599 };
1600
1601 void send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run);
1602 void settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply, std::exception_ptr const& error);
1603 void next(std::string const& serialKey);
1604 void applyOptimistic(Run& run);
1605 void dropLayers(Run& run);
1606
1607 MutationDecl const* _decl;
1608 RtScope* _scope;
1609 ModelAlias* _alias;
1610 std::string _typeId;
1611 ScreenCore* _core;
1612 reactive::Signal<int> _inFlight;
1613 reactive::Signal<Value> _result;
1614 reactive::Signal<Value> _error;
1615 reactive::Signal<Value> _errorKind;
1616 reactive::Signal<Value> _refusal;
1617 std::uint64_t _runs = 0;
1618 std::uint64_t _latest = 0;
1619 std::map<std::string, std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Run>>, std::less<>> _queues;
1620 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _busy;
1621 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
1622};

1671/// @brief An `actionButton` part, lowered in the scope of the list it belongs to: what a screen's head shows and
1672/// an overlay's footer draws as buttons.
1673struct ActionModel {
1674 /// @brief The action's id, unique in its list.
1675 std::string id;
1676 /// @brief The part's JSON Pointer, where a diagnostic about it is reported.
1677 std::string path;
1678 /// @brief The label.
1679 Prop<std::string> label;
1680 /// @brief The name of an icon; empty for none.
1681 Prop<std::string> icon;
1682 /// @brief Whether the button draws its icon alone, the label being its accessible name and tooltip.
1683 Prop<bool> iconOnly = false;
1684 /// @brief How much it stands out.
1685 ButtonEmphasis emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Normal;
1686 /// @brief Whether it can be run.
1687 Prop<bool> enabled = true;
1688 /// @brief Whether it is shown.
1689 Prop<bool> visible = true;
1690 /// @brief Runs its `onClick` as a user event, in one batch; empty when it declares none.
1691 Action run;
1692};
1693
1694/// @brief A list of lowered `actionButton` parts, in document order.
1695using ActionModels = std::vector<ActionModel>;
1696
1697/// @brief A `headBadge` part, lowered in the screen scope.
1698struct BadgeModel {
1699 /// @brief The badge's text.
1700 Prop<std::string> text;
1701 /// @brief Its tone.
1702 Prop<Tone> tone = Tone::Neutral;
1703 /// @brief The name of an icon; empty for none.
1704 Prop<std::string> icon;
1705 /// @brief Whether it is shown.
1706 Prop<bool> visible = true;
1707};
1708
1709/// @brief A `headMenuItem` part, lowered in the screen scope: the entry as a menu item, with the id
1710/// `ScreenHead::choose` takes and its submenu's entries beside it.
1711struct HeadMenuModel {
1712 /// @brief The entry's id; empty for a separator or a submenu.
1713 std::string id;
1714 /// @brief The part's JSON Pointer, where a diagnostic about it is reported.
1715 std::string path;
1716 /// @brief The entry, its own `items` empty.
1717 MenuItem item;
1718 /// @brief The submenu's entries; empty for an entry that is chosen.
1719 std::vector<HeadMenuModel> items;
1720};
1721
1722/// @brief A `headTool` part, lowered in the screen scope.
1723struct HeadToolModel {
1724 /// @brief The tool's id, unique among the head's tools.
1725 std::string id;
1726 /// @brief The part's JSON Pointer, where a diagnostic about it is reported.
1727 std::string path;
1728 /// @brief A search field or a select.
1729 HeadToolKind kind = HeadToolKind::Search;
1730 /// @brief The accessible name.
1731 Prop<std::string> label;
1732 /// @brief A search's text.
1733 Prop<std::string> value;
1734 /// @brief A search's placeholder.
1735 Prop<std::string> placeholder;
1736 /// @brief A select's options.
1737 Prop<std::vector<SelectOption>> options;
1738 /// @brief A select's chosen key, or none.
1739 Prop<std::optional<Key>> selected;
1740 /// @brief The width in units; 0 for the content's.
1741 int width = 0;
1742 /// @brief Whether it can be used.
1743 Prop<bool> enabled = true;
1744 /// @brief Whether it is shown.
1745 Prop<bool> visible = true;
1746 /// @brief Runs a search's `onChange` or a select's `onChoose` with `event` the edit, as a user event.
1747 std::function<void(Value)> edit;
1748 /// @brief Runs a search's `onSubmit` with `event` its text, as a user event; empty for a select.
1749 std::function<void(Value)> submit;
1750};
1751
1752/// @brief How many command lists the inspector's log keeps.
1753inline constexpr std::size_t kCommandLogSize = 256;
1754
1755/// @brief How often, in lowered nodes, the inspector's node list drops the nodes whose scope is gone.
1756inline constexpr std::size_t kPruneLoweredAt = 256;
1757
1758/// @brief The key a command is written with.
1759/// @param kind The command's kind.
1760/// @return Its key, such as `refetch`.
1761[[nodiscard]] MORPH_API std::string commandKey(CommandKind kind);
1762
1763/// @brief What the horizontal positions of a chart's points have been, across every series.
1764struct ChartAxisKinds {
1765 /// @brief A position was a number.
1766 bool numbers = false;
1767 /// @brief A position was a date or an instant.
1768 bool instants = false;
1769};
1770
1771/// @brief One reference line of a chart as the lowering reads it, before its default label is known.
1772struct ChartRawLine {
1773 /// @brief Where it is drawn, in the chart's unit.
1774 math::Rational value;
1775 /// @brief Its label; none takes the value at the chart's places.
1776 std::optional<std::string> label;
1777 /// @brief Its colour.
1778 Tone tone = Tone::Neutral;
1779 /// @brief Its stroke.
1780 ChartLineStyle style = ChartLineStyle::Solid;
1781};
1782
1783/// @brief One point of a chart's series as the lowering reads it, before the range is known.
1784struct ChartRawPoint {
1785 /// @brief The element's position in the series' list.
1786 std::size_t index = 0;
1787 /// @brief Its `x`: a number, or an instant's milliseconds since the epoch; none without `x`.
1788 std::optional<math::Rational> x;
1789 /// @brief Its value in the chart's unit; none is a gap.
1790 std::optional<math::Rational> y;
1791 /// @brief Its label on the horizontal axis.
1792 std::string xLabel;
1793 /// @brief The tone that marks it.
1794 std::optional<Tone> tone;
1795 /// @brief The text beside it.
1796 std::string note;
1797};
