1799/// @brief One mounted screen's interpreter: its document, diagnostics, slots and preferences, and the code that
1800/// declares scopes, lowers nodes and runs commands.
1801class MORPH_API ScreenCore {
1802public:
1803 /// @brief The core of a screen about to mount.
1804 /// @param doc The document.
1805 /// @param owner The session.
1806 /// @param calls The dispatcher.
1807 /// @param options The interpreter's options.
1808 /// @param mount The mount's options.
1809 ScreenCore(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc, Session& owner, Dispatcher& calls,
1810 InterpreterOptions const& options, MountOptions const& mount);
1811
1812 ScreenCore(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
1813 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
1814 ScreenCore(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
1815 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
1816 /// @brief Takes the screen off the session, so a later backend switch does not run its `onBackendChange`.
1817 ~ScreenCore() { session.detachScreen(*this); }
1818
1819 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle list in the document's own scope, as a screen's or app document's own command list.
1820 /// @param key The lifecycle key, such as `onBackendChange`.
1821 void runLifecycleOf(std::string_view key);
1822
1823 /// @brief The document.
1824 /// @return It.
1825 [[nodiscard]] Document const& doc() const noexcept { return *_doc; }
1826
1827 /// @brief The runtime.
1828 /// @return It.
1829 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return session.runtime(); }
1830
1831 /// @brief Reports a diagnostic once per path.
1832 /// @param path Where.
1833 /// @param reason What.
1834 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason);
1835
1836 /// @brief The next slot id: the interpreter numbers every bound property of the document.
1837 /// @return It.
1838 [[nodiscard]] SlotId nextSlot() noexcept { return _slots++; }
1839
1840 // --- Declaring a scope -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1841
1842 /// @brief Declares a scope's names and starts its reactive parts.
1843 /// @param scope The scope.
1844 /// @param decl Its declarations; `nullptr` when it declares none.
1845 /// @param content The nodes whose elements belong to it.
1846 /// @param commands The command lists whose transfers belong to it.
1847 void declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
1848 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands);
1849
1850 /// @brief Makes a state's signal from its init, once.
1851 /// @param scope The scope that declares it.
1852 /// @param slot The state.
1853 void initState(RtScope const& scope, StateSlot& slot) const;
1854
1855 /// @brief Reads an element value. A tracked read.
1856 /// @param element The element.
1857 /// @param name The value's name.
1858 /// @return The value.
1859 [[nodiscard]] Value elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const;
1860 /// @brief Whether @p element is a group with an element inside it the user touched: a group has no value of its
1861 /// own to touch, so its errors show under the `touched` policy once any of its inputs is.
1862 /// @param element The element.
1863 /// @return True when it is such a group.
1864 [[nodiscard]] static bool touchedWithin(ElementState const& element);
1865
1866 /// @brief The current value of an input, checkbox or select: what `required` tests.
1867 /// @param element The element.
1868 /// @return The value.
1869 [[nodiscard]] Value inputValue(ElementState const& element) const;
1870
1871 // --- Commands ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1872
1873 /// @brief Runs a command list: each command in order in one batch; done when every command in it is.
1874 /// @param commands The list.
1875 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
1876 /// @param done Called once, with whether every command succeeded; may be empty.
1877 void runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
1878
1879 /// @brief Runs one command.
1880 /// @param command The command.
1881 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
1882 /// @param done Called once, with whether it succeeded.
1883 void runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
1884
1885 /// @brief Runs a command list for an event of the user's.
1886 /// @param commands The list; `nullptr` runs nothing.
1887 /// @param ctx Where it was lowered.
1888 /// @param event The event's payload.
1889 void runEvent(Commands const* commands, LowerCtx const& ctx, Value event);
1890
1891 /// @brief Lowers a list of `actionButton` parts into reactive models: label, icon, enabled and visible bound in
1892 /// @p ctx's scope, and a run function that runs the part's `onClick` there as a user event.
1893 /// @param parts The parts, in order.
1894 /// @param ctx The scope the list belongs to.
1895 /// @return The models, in the parts' order.
1896 [[nodiscard]] ActionModels lowerActionParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1897
1898 /// @brief Lowers a screen head's `menu` in the scope @p ctx names.
1899 /// @param parts The `headMenuItem` parts.
1900 /// @param ctx The scope.
1901 /// @return The entries, in document order, submenus included.
1902 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadMenuModel> lowerHeadMenu(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1903
1904 /// @brief Lowers a screen head's `tools` in the scope @p ctx names.
1905 /// @param parts The `headTool` parts.
1906 /// @param ctx The scope.
1907 /// @return The tools, in document order.
1908 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<HeadToolModel> lowerHeadTools(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1909
1910 /// @brief An overlay's actions as the action bar its footer shows: a button per action, test id
1911 /// `action_<id>`, shown and enabled as the action is.
1912 /// @param actions The lowered actions, in order.
1913 /// @return The `ActionBar` node.
1914 [[nodiscard]] static Node actionBarOf(ActionModels actions);
1915
1916 /// @brief Lowers a screen head's `headBadge` parts, bound in @p ctx's scope.
1917 /// @param parts The parts, in order.
1918 /// @param ctx The screen scope.
1919 /// @return The badges, in the parts' order.
1920 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<BadgeModel> lowerBadgeParts(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1921
1922 // --- Lowering ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1923
1924 /// @brief Lowers a document node to a view node.
1925 /// @param node The node.
1926 /// @param ctx Where.
1927 /// @return The view node.
1928 [[nodiscard]] Node lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1929
1930 /// @brief Lowers a node list into one node: the node itself, or a column of them.
1931 /// @param nodes The nodes.
1932 /// @param ctx Where.
1933 /// @param gap The spacing step between the nodes of a list of several; a single node is lowered unwrapped.
1934 /// @return The node.
1935 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested node of the document.
1936 [[nodiscard]] Node lowerAll(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& ctx, int gap = 0);
1937
1938 /// @brief The size request of one child of a holder.
1939 /// @param node The child.
1940 /// @param own The names the holder's own scope declares.
1941 /// @param ctx Where the holder is lowered.
1942 /// @return The child's hints; content size where its sizing reads a name in @p own.
1943 [[nodiscard]] LayoutHints nodeHints(DocNode const& node, std::set<std::string, std::less<>> const& own,
1944 LowerCtx const& ctx);
1945
1946 /// @brief Reports each child of an overlay's or a case's content that sizes itself by a share, once at @p path,
1947 /// and
1948 /// makes it fill the holder instead.
1949 /// @param children The content, lowered.
1950 /// @param path Where the report points.
1951 void fillHolder(std::vector<Node>& children, std::string const& path);
1952 /// @brief The size request of a holder of @p content: the largest stretch of its children on each axis.
1953 ///
1954 /// A literal sizing is read as written and a computed one is evaluated once in the enclosing scope. A computed
1955 /// sizing that reads a name the holder's own scope declares cannot be evaluated before the holder mounts; it is
1956 /// reported and counts as content.
1957 /// @param content The holder's document children.
1958 /// @param decl The declarations of the holder's own scope; `nullptr` for none.
1959 /// @param ctx Where the holder is lowered.
1960 /// @return The hints; bounds and `alignSelf` stay unset, because they belong to a child.
1961 [[nodiscard]] LayoutHints holderHints(std::span<DocNode const* const> content, ScopeDecl const* decl,
1962 LowerCtx const& ctx);
1963
1964 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes): the screen's shared state, which its
1965 // scopes and runtimes read and write directly.
1966 /// @brief The session.
1967 Session& session;
1968 /// @brief The dispatcher.
1969 Dispatcher& dispatcher;
1970 /// @brief The host; may be `nullptr`.
1971 InterpreterHost* host;
1972 /// @brief The diagnostic callback.
1973 std::function<void(Refusal const&)> onDiagnostic;
1974 /// @brief Moves focus to a mounted element by its id; empty until the screen is mounted, and again once it is
1975 /// unmounting.
1976 std::function<bool(std::string_view)> focusElement;
1977 /// @brief The models the opener lends.
1978 std::map<std::string, BorrowedModel, std::less<>> borrowed;
1979 /// @brief The screen scope's reactive depth.
1980 std::size_t depth;
1981 /// @brief The diagnostics reported, in order.
1982 std::vector<Refusal> diagnostics;
1983 /// @brief The paths and reasons already reported.
1984 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> reported;
1985 /// The sheet whose regions are being lowered, while they are.
1986 std::optional<PageGeometry> pageBeingLowered;
1987 /// @brief The customization choices, by point.
1988 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> prefs;
1989 /// @brief The points' defaults.
1990 ValueRecord prefDefaults;
1991 /// @brief The screen's `submitted`.
1992 reactive::Signal<bool> submitted;
1993 /// @brief The open dialogs and drawers, the mutation runs and the transfers in flight, across every scope of the
1994 /// screen: what a close waits for (spec 6 §3).
1995 reactive::Signal<int> pendingWork;
1996 /// @brief Whether this screen records what the inspector reads: its session's `developmentTools`, read once.
1997 bool const recording;
1998
1999 /// @brief Counts pending work in or out.
2000 /// @param delta What started (positive) or ended (negative).
2001 void addPending(int delta) { pendingWork.set(pendingWork.peek() + delta); }
2002 /// @brief The document's own scope, once mounted.
2003 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> rootScope;
2004 /// @brief A state of the screen this one replaces: its declared type's name and its value.
2005 struct KeptState {
2006 /// @brief The declared type's name.
2007 std::string type;
2008 /// @brief The value.
2009 Value value;
2010 };
2011 /// @brief The states of the own scope of the screen this one replaces, by name (`MountOptions::keepStateOf`).
2012 std::map<std::string, KeptState, std::less<>> keptStates;
2013 /// @brief A node as it was lowered, which the inspector lists while its scope lives.
2014 struct LoweredNode {
2015 /// @brief The node.
2016 DocNode const* node = nullptr;
2017 /// @brief The scope it was lowered in.
2018 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> scope;
2019 /// @brief The names bound where it was lowered.
2020 std::weak_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
2021 };
2022 /// @brief Every node lowered, in lowering order; an entry whose scope is gone is pruned as more are added.
2023 std::vector<LoweredNode> loweredNodes;
2024 /// @brief The screen's live scopes, in creation order.
2025 std::vector<RtScope*> scopes;
2026 /// @brief The latest command lists run, oldest first, at most `kCommandLogSize`.
2027 std::deque<CommandLogEntry> commandLog;
2028 /// @brief Set while the inspector evaluates, so that an expression error it meets is not reported.
2029 bool inspecting = false;
2030 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes)
2031
2032 /// @brief The value a state of the screen's own scope keeps from the screen it replaces: that screen's value of
2033 /// the state of the same name, when its declared type is the same and admits it.
2034 /// @param scope The scope that declares the state.
2035 /// @param decl The declaration.
2036 /// @return The value, or nothing for a state that starts from its init.
2037 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Value> keptState(RtScope const& scope, StateDecl const& decl) const;
2038
2039 /// @brief What a form session submits through; the same type as `forms::Submitter`.
2040 using FormSubmitter =
2041 std::function<async::Completion<std::string>(std::string_view actionType, std::string bodyJson)>;
2042
2043private:
2044 void wireElement(ElementState& element);
2045 void wireErrors(ElementState& element);
2046 /// A table's rows in the order of its sort, read in the table's scope with @p bindings. A sort that is not a
2047 /// list of the table's sortable columns, or whose values cannot be ordered, is reported and leaves the source
2048 /// order.
2049 void sortedRows(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings, TableView& view);
2050 /// A grouped table's runs of its source rows by its `group`'s `by`: each row's run index and each run's heading
2051 /// entry, into @p view.
2052 static void groupRows(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings, TableView& view);
2053 /// A table's sorted rows and the page of them it shows, by its `pageSize` and `page`.
2054 TableView tableView(ElementState const& element, Bindings const* bindings);
2055 void collect(DocNode const& node, RtScope& scope, std::vector<Commands const*>& commands);
2056 /// The readers every kind's lowering shares, bound to one node.
2057 class KindKit;
2058 /// A column or a row. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2059 Node lowerStack(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2060 /// A grid. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2061 Node lowerGrid(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2062 /// A panel. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2063 Node lowerPanel(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2064 /// A splitter. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2065 Node lowerSplitter(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2066 /// A collapsible section. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2067 Node lowerCollapsible(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2068 /// Reports the `gap` of each `forEach` directly in an action bar whose computed `axis` is horizontal: such a
2069 /// `forEach` is part of the bar's row and takes the theme's action gap. A literal axis is refused at load.
2070 void reportActionBarGaps(DocNode const& bar, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2071 /// A drop zone. Its own function, so a deep document stacks only what this kind needs per level.
2072 Node lowerDropZone(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2073 /// A page, its regions lowered with its geometry in hand.
2074 Node lowerPage(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2075 /// A page region; only a page lowers one.
2076 Node lowerPageRegion(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2077 /// A locale scope: a holder column over a scope that writes in another locale.
2078 Node lowerLocaleScope(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2079 Node lowerKind(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2080 /// The leaf-like kinds, from `text` to `menu`; empty for any other kind. They are lowered apart from the
2081 /// containers so that a deep document does not stack their locals once per level: `lowerKind` recurses into
2082 /// its children, and in an unoptimised build a frame holds every branch's locals at once.
2083 std::optional<Node> lowerWidget(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2084 /// The display kinds, from `banner` to `emptyState`, apart from the containers for the same reason as
2085 /// `lowerWidget`; empty for any other kind.
2086 std::optional<Node> lowerDisplay(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2087 Node lowerDialog(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2088 Node lowerSwitch(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2089 Node lowerRows(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2090 /// A grouped table's heading row: its `group`'s `heading`, lowered as one cell in a row scope of its own whose
2091 /// row is the group's run record and whose key is `key`, the row's canonical key, as a data row's scope has.
2092 TableRowView headingRow(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, reactive::Signal<Value> const& row,
2093 std::string key);
2094 /// A `rowTone` value as a tone: `neutral`, `info`, `ok`, `warn`, `err`, or `null` for none. Another value is
2095 /// reported, at @p path, while @p noted is still false, and shows no tone.
2096 std::optional<Tone> rowToneOf(Value const& value, std::string const& path, bool& noted);
2097 /// A `rowSpans` value as spans: a list of `{column, rows}` records, `column` a column's id from @p columns and
2098 /// `rows` an integer from 1; `null` and `[]` are none. A record of another shape is dropped and reported once
2099 /// through @p noted.
2100 std::vector<RowSpan> rowSpansOf(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& columns,
2101 std::string const& path, bool& noted);
2102 Node lowerBoundary(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2103 /// A group: a column of its legend (a text carrying the mark), its children, its description and its shown
2104 /// errors, named and announced as a group.
2105 Node lowerGroup(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, std::vector<Node> children);
2106 Node lowerCustom(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2107 Node lowerChart(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
2108 /// Everything a chart draws, read from its node in @p scope; the one tracked read of the chart's binding.
2109 ChartData chartData(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings);
2110 /// One series' points, read exactly: each value in @p unit, the chart's, which the first value fixes.
2111 std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint> chartPoints(DocNode const& series, RtScope const& scope,
2112 Bindings const* bindings, std::optional<std::string>& unit,
2113 detail::ChartAxisKinds& kinds);
2114 /// A chart value as an exact magnitude in @p unit, which the first value read fixes; a value that is not a number
2115 /// or does not convert is reported at @p path and read as none.
2116 std::optional<math::Rational> chartMagnitude(Value const& value, std::string const& path,
2117 std::optional<std::string>& unit);
2118 /// A chart tone: one of the five names, or `null` for none; another value is reported at @p path.
2119 std::optional<Tone> chartToneOf(Value const& value, std::string const& path);
2120 /// A point's `x` as a number or an instant's milliseconds, noting its kind in @p kinds; none for `null`, and for
2121 /// another value, which is reported at @p path.
2122 std::optional<math::Rational> chartPosition(Value const& value, std::string const& path,
2123 detail::ChartAxisKinds& kinds);
2124 /// A chart's reference lines, read exactly in @p unit; a line whose value is `null` or not a number is left out.
2125 std::vector<detail::ChartRawLine> chartLines(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings,
2126 std::optional<std::string>& unit);
2127 /// @p range with `yMin` and `yMax` in place of its computed ends; ends that leave it empty are reported, and
2128 /// @p range is kept.
2129 ChartRange chartFixedRange(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings,
2130 std::optional<std::string>& unit, ChartRange const& range);
2131 /// The drawn series: each point at its own `x` when @p positioned, else at its index, clipped to @p range.
2132 static void chartSeries(ChartData& data, DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings,
2133 std::vector<std::vector<detail::ChartRawPoint>>& series, bool positioned,
2134 ChartRange const& range);
2135 /// A form field's control drawn by the host component its overlay names, with the built-in control as the
2136 /// fallback.
2137 Node fieldComponent(forms::FieldView const& view, DocNode const& overlay, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2138 /// A custom node's prop of a declared type over @p read, converted as `lowerCustom` converts a document's.
2139 CustomProp componentProp(std::string const& prop, std::string const& type, std::function<Value()> read);
2140 /// A field component's `change`: the payload read as the `value` prop's type and written as the user's edit, or
2141 /// reported when it does not decode, does not fit the field, or is over the inline cap for a base64 member.
2142 void changeField(forms::FieldState& state, forms::FieldSpec const& spec, std::string const& path,
2143 std::string_view valueType, std::string const& payload);
2144 Node lowerCustomize(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2145 [[nodiscard]] std::string arrangedBy(std::string const& elementId) const;

2188 /// @brief A bound property: a constant for a literal, a numbered slot otherwise.
2189 template <typename T, typename Convert>
2190 Prop<T> bindProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr, T fallback, Convert convert) {
2191 if (!expr) {
2192 return Prop<T>{std::move(fallback)};
2193 }
2194 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
2195 return Prop<T>{convert(expr->literal, ctx.scope->formatting())};
2196 }
2197 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(nextSlot(), [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr, convert]() -> T {
2198 return convert(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), scope->formatting());
2199 })};
2200 }
2201
2202 /// @brief A text's role: a literal one as the loader checked it; a computed one evaluated in its slot, where a
2203 /// name of no role is reported once for its path and drawn `Normal`.
2204 Prop<TextRole> roleProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr);
2205 /// A key-value item: its caption, its value or spans, and its tone, each problem reported once at @p path.
2206 KeyValueItem keyValueItemOf(Value const& item, std::string const& path, RtScope const& scope);
2207 /// A text's or a banner's `spans`, reported once at its path when it drops a run.
2208 Prop<std::vector<TextSpan>> spansProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr);
2209
2210 /// @brief A node's surface: the name of a theme surface, or empty for the default. A computed one is evaluated in
2211 /// its slot; `null` is no surface, and any other value that is not a string is reported for the node's
2212 /// `surface` path and drawn as no surface.
2213 Prop<std::string> surfaceOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
2214
2215 /// @brief A property read through @p read, as a numbered slot.
2216 template <typename T, typename Read>
2217 Prop<T> slotProp(Read read) {
2218 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(nextSlot(), std::move(read))};
2219 }
2220
2221 /// @brief Evaluates an expression once, untracked: a property the view tree sets once.
2222 [[nodiscard]] Value once(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) const;
2223
2224 /// @brief Keeps a command list in the inspector's log.
2225 void logList(Commands const& commands);
2226
2227 std::shared_ptr<Document const> _doc;
2228 SlotId _slots = 1;
2229 /// @brief Expires with the screen, so a reply that arrives after it is gone reports nothing.
2230 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
2231};

2355/// @brief A mounted screen: its scopes, its view mounted through `Mounted`, and what its host asks of it.
2356///
2357/// Neither copyable nor movable. It belongs to the runtime's owner; the runtime, the session, the dispatcher and
2358/// the backend outlive it. Destroying it runs `onUnmount`, unmounts the view and releases every scope.
2359class MORPH_API Screen {
2360public:
2361 Screen(Screen const&) = delete;
2362 Screen& operator=(Screen const&) = delete;

2375 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& id() const noexcept { return _core->doc().id; }
2376

2378 /// test inspects.
2379 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
2380 /// @return The value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
2381 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const;
2382
2383 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `title`.
2384 /// @return It, or `null`.

2386

2388 /// @return It, or `null`.

2400 /// is one of a nested scope, which is mounted per row or per opening and so names no one instance.
2401 /// @return Them, in declaration order.
2402 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<BoundAlias> boundAliases() const;

2404 /// @brief Whether the screen's shown root lays itself at the page's edges (`pageEdge`). A tracked read: it starts
2405 /// at the view's root, and while the node is a `switch` it moves to the case shown now (the default when
2406 /// none matches) if that holds exactly one node, so a width- or state-dependent root is seen through.
2407 /// A case that declares a scope of its own is not entered, since its names are not the screen's.

2419 [[nodiscard]] LeadPlacement leadPlacement() const;

2618/// @brief The app document mounted as the root scope every screen of the session shares (spec 6 §5).
2619///
2620/// Its state, lets, queries and mutations live once for the session. A screen reads them as `{"ref": "app.name"}`,
2621/// a binding on one updates, and `{"set": "app.name", …}` writes the app document's state. A query of the app
2622/// document runs once however many screens read it. Destroying the root runs its `onUnmount`, takes its scope off the
2623/// session and releases its model instances; a host does that before it clears the session on sign-out.
2624class AppRoot {
2625public:
2626 AppRoot(AppRoot const&) = delete;
2627 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot const&) = delete;
2628 AppRoot(AppRoot&&) = delete;
2629 AppRoot& operator=(AppRoot&&) = delete;
2630
2631 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, takes the scope off the session, and releases everything.
2632 ~AppRoot();
2633
2634 /// @brief The app document's `navigation` badges that are visible now, in order, each with the screen whose
2635 /// navigator entry it goes on, and following the app state they read.
2636 /// @return They, valid as long as the root; empty when the document declares no `navigation`.
2637 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Computed<std::vector<NavigationBadge>> const& navigationBadges() const;

2703/// @brief Mounts UI documents (spec 5): one per client process or window, over a session and a dispatcher.
2704class MORPH_API Interpreter {
2705public:
2706 /// @brief An interpreter.
2707 /// @param session The session the screens share. Borrowed.
2708 /// @param dispatcher Where model calls go. Borrowed.
2709 /// @param options The host and the diagnostic callback.
2710 Interpreter(Session& session MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, Dispatcher& dispatcher MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
2711 InterpreterOptions options = {})
2712 : _session{&session}, _dispatcher{&dispatcher}, _options{std::move(options)} {}
2713
2714 /// @brief Mounts a screen.
2715 ///
2716 /// The document has loaded (`loadDocument`); what mounting adds is what only the opener knows: the params, and
2717 /// the models a `{"from": alias}` instance borrows. A param that is missing and not optional, a param of the
2718 /// wrong type, a borrowed model the opener did not lend and a document without a view are refused.
2719 /// @param doc The document.
2720 /// @param params The params, by name; names the document does not declare are ignored.
2721 /// @param backend The backend to mount on. Borrowed: it outlives the screen.
2722 /// @param options Where to mount, and the models lent.
2723 /// @return The screen, or the refusal.
2724 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
2725 ValueRecord const& params,
2726 IViewBackend& backend,
2727 MountOptions const& options = {});
2728
2729 /// @brief Mounts the app document as the session's root scope (spec 6 §5).
2730 ///
2731 /// Refused: a document whose id is not `app`, and a second app document while one is mounted on the session.
2732 /// @param doc The app document, loaded.
2733 /// @return The root, or the refusal. Keep it as long as the session's screens may read `app.*`.
2734 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<AppRoot>, Refusal> mountApp(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc);
2735
2736private:
2737 Session* _session;
2738 Dispatcher* _dispatcher;
2739 InterpreterOptions _options;
2740};
